play_station.name: Play station
play_station.description: Adds a radio station to Music Assistant (with its name and logo) and plays it on a Music Assistant player.

name.name: Name
name.description: Station name (the Globe Radio prefix is added).

image_url.name: Logo URL
image_url.description: Full URL of the logo, reachable from the Music Assistant server.

cleanup.name: Clean up stations
cleanup.description: Removes the stations added by Globe Radio from the Music Assistant library. Favorites and the station being played are kept.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Only list what would be removed.
